column2: WARNING Transformer Cooling Fans Sign – Fans Can Start On Oil Temperature – 8x12 Aluminum
column3:
Fans Can Start On Oil Temperature. This WARNING Transformer Cooling Fans sign from CGAP Safety reads: TRANSFORMER COOLING FANS / CAN START ON OIL TEMPERATURE / AND CUT HANDS AT RADIATOR FINS / LOCK OUT FAN POWER BEFORE WORK. Written for electric substations, generating stations, utility transformer yards.

Why this sign matters

Cooling fans are switched on by oil or winding temperature controls, so a fan that is idle can spin up while hands are near the blades during fin cleaning.

Where to post it

On the transformer radiator bank beside the fan guards, at the spot where crews stand to wash or inspect radiator fins.

Who orders it

Substation maintenance supervisors.

Rust-resistant .065 aluminum, UV-resistant print, pre-drilled in all four corners. Made in the USA. Related standards to review for your site: OSHA 1910.147; ANSI Z535.2. A sign supports your safety program; it does not replace guarding, lockout or training.

column2: WARNING Breaker Charging Springs Sign – Charged Springs Can Snap Linkage Closed – 8x12 Aluminum
column3:

column2: WARNING Turbine Lube Oil Filter Sign – Hot Oil Can Spray From Filter Cover – 8x12 Aluminum

The embossing dies close with heavy force. Hands placing or straightening a blank can be crushed in the dies.

On the press frame at the feed station.

Inking rollers form in-running nips. A rag wiping turning rollers can be grabbed and pull the hand and arm in.

On the press side frame next to the roller access guard.

Print shop supervisors.
